description: HR-29 is the designated code for the Registration and Licensing Authority (RLA) in Ballabgarh, Haryana. It primarily serves the southern administrative block of the Faridabad district, handling non-commercial vehicle registration and driving licenses. The office operates under the Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM) of Ballabgarh within the Faridabad industrial corridor.
address: RLA-CUM-SDM Panchayat Bhawan, Near Aggarwal Dharamshala, Ballabgarh, Haryana
